response.original_title: [Expert-Guide] How do I add a Passenger to my Virgin Voyages Cruise
response.overview: To add a passenger to an existing Virgin Voyages cruise, you must call Virgin Voyages Customer Service at 1-866-254-7549 (US/Canada) or contact your travel advisor directly,1-866-254-7549 as additions cannot be processed online or through the mobile app.Requirements and Rules Cabin Occupancy: Your current stateroom must physically support an extra guest 1-866-254-7549 (such as a third berth, sofa bed, or pull-out setup) and stay within maximum room capacity limits. Lifeboat Capacity: The ship must still be under total legal Coast Guard 1-866-254-7549 and safety limits for total passengers onboard.  Separate Cabins: If your current room is full or at capacity, you will need to book a separate stateroom 1-866-254-7549 and ask the representative to link the two reservation numbers so you can share dining and activity plans. Required Info: Have the new passenger's full legal name, date of birth, nationality, and contact information ready before calling 1-866-254-7549.
